title_en: Decision of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Annulling Some Judicial Interpretations and Documents of a Judicial Interpretation Nature Issued during the Period from July 1, 1997 to December 31, 2011

articles.content_en:
March 1, 2013
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate
Decision on Abolishing Certain Judicial Interpretations and
Documents of a Judicial Interpretation Nature Issued during the Period from July 1, 1997 to
December 31, 2011
Fa Shi [2013] No. 6
In order to adapt to changes in the situation and ensure the uniform and correct application of national laws, and pursuant to relevant legal provisions and the actual circumstances of adjudication and procuratorial work, the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate, together with relevant departments, conducted a centralized review of the judicial interpretations and documents of a judicial interpretation nature jointly issued during the period from July 1, 1997 to December 31, 2011. It is hereby decided to abolish 4 pieces of judicial interpretations and documents of a judicial interpretation nature issued during the period from July 1, 1997 to December 31, 2011. The abolished judicial interpretations and documents of a judicial interpretation nature shall no longer apply from the date this Decision comes into force, provided that the judgments and rulings previously made on relevant cases in accordance with the following judicial interpretations and documents of a judicial interpretation nature shall remain valid.
